description: Single source-of-truth synthetic fixture for headline planning numbers used across this demo (annual budget, forecast new customer orders, cost per new order, monthly budget weights, channel taxonomy). All figures here are clearly-labelled illustrative placeholders, not Freemans performance data - see brief section 5.

annual_summary.note: cost_per_new_policy_sale_gbp = total_media_budget_gbp / forecast_new_policy_sales. forecast_quote_starts = forecast_new_policy_sales / (quote_to_policy_conversion_pct / 100). Affiliates is budgeted as a normal channel in this taxonomy, alongside the other five.

monthly_budget_weights_note: March and September are illustrative UK seasonal trading peaks (1 March / 1 September registration changes are a real public UK retail trading fact) - the specific weight values are a synthetic planning assumption for this demo, not evidence of Freemans' actual phasing.

data_readiness_groups.effectiveness_modelling: Effectiveness & Modelling - MMM, incrementality tests, experiments, response curves, attribution, brand lift.
data_readiness_groups.quote_policy_renewal: Checkout and Order Performance - checkout starts, completions, customer orders, cost per order, product, geography, renewals, cancellations.
data_readiness_groups.pcw_distribution: Affiliate/Cashback & Distribution Performance - position, click, quote and sale feeds, commissions, attribution rules, freshness.
data_readiness_groups.customer_vehicle_audience: Customer & Audience Data - approved aggregate segments for Multi-Category, new customers, Flexi Pay, Electricals/Home Tech, life stage, geography.
data_readiness_groups.pricing_risk_guardrails: Pricing, Risk & Commercial Guardrails - only approved aggregate constraints or value bands; detailed pricing/credit-risk logic stays outside the planner and LLM.
data_readiness_groups.plans_budgets_creative_approvals: Plans, Budgets, Creative & Approvals - annual brief, media budget, channel plans, creative matrix, claims substantiation, promotion approvals.
data_readiness_groups.digital_crm_platform: Digital & Platform Data - paid-search, social, programmatic, website analytics, CRM, app reporting.
data_readiness_groups.market_competitor_context: Market, Competitor & Context Signals - prices, search interest, seasonal trading peaks, weather, retail safety, competitor bursts, regulatory changes.
data_readiness_groups.media_owner_channel: Media Owner & Channel Data - reach, frequency, delivery, rate cards, inventory, audience availability.
